summary: RAG reasoned few-shot topology + champion LoRA v2a_e1
hypothesis: Crossing the ragReasonedFewShot in-context topology (exp018) onto the best LoRA adapter (v2a_e1) should combine retrieval-grounded reasoning with fine-tuned weights, beating either ingredient alone.
technique: A matrix sweep pairing all inference topologies against the best LoRA adapter: specifically, the RAG + reasoned few-shot in-context pipeline (exp018) is re-run with the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 driving the generation call, evaluated greedy on the full-30 held-out set.
result: Scored 0.313 on the full-30 greedy gate — a clear improvement over the raw exp018 topology baseline (0.247) but well below the champion exp056 (0.440). The combination of RAG few-shot reasoning and the LoRA adapter did not compound their individual strengths sufficiently, and the run was discarded.
